mep.f: (EU politics, countable) Initialism of Member of the European Parliament.

s.g: (pharmacology) The United States Adopted Name of pethidine.
The recreational drug 4-methylmethcathinone, related to cathinone.
Showing the cunning or ingenuity or wickedness typical of a devil.
A fiendish person, especially one who tricks someone into following a destructive or disastrous course of action; a tempter.
Foul-smelling or noxious, particularly of a gas or atmosphere.
A poisonous or foul-smelling gas, especially as emitted from the earth; an unpleasant smell.
(homeopathy) A dilution of fluids derived from skunks or polecats.
(pharmacology) A carbamate derivative used as an anxiolytic (anxiety-reducing) drug.
